'''Microdroids''' were small [[Droid/Legends|droids]] designed for use as a [[Listening device/Legends|listening device]].

==Description==
No longer than ten [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]], microdroids were spiderlike and capable of locomotion. Installed by owners as audio bugs, they were equipped with pre-programmed instructions to return to their owners after a set period of time or after detecting a specific keyword of audio cue. They were hard to detect because they produce low volume transmissions. While they were not capable of self-defense, some models were equipped to self-destruct if tampered with.<ref name="EV" />

Some variants of microdroid were adjusted to fight as [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]] in [[microdroid wrestling]] matches, or to serve as trackers and do surveillance. They could be designed to look like a [[Piranha beetle/Legends|piranha beetle]] on treads, or like a [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], among others. Such droids fought each other in the [[Maw Casino]] on the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', and people would place bets on which droid they thought would win the fight.
